job: Switch the same data between two views, such as a table and its JSON.
purpose: A small segmented control of fd-viewswitch-item buttons. Each item shows the panel whose data-view matches its data-value, inside the element named by data-target or the nearest data-fd-views. Fires fd:change with the chosen value.
useWhen: One result has a Table and a JSON view.
A response is shown as rendered and as raw text.

avoidWhen.when: Moving between different pages or sections.
A control that sets a value in a form.
Language tabs on a code block.

states.name: selected
states.how: aria-selected="true" on the active item; its panel is shown

variants.useWhen: A taller switch for use outside a toolbar.

keyboard.does: Move to the previous or next view and select it; they wrap.
Select the first or last view.
